GAP3 refined on the audit lane's reply of 2026-10-03: 'only from a relation' was main's inference, not the lane's result. Seven exact-once changes by adoption/amend.py; README and the lock plan propagated; B1458's version pin loosened. The lock's last owner-held items are paid. Nothing selects a state. 0 of 19.
